summary: Zimmer Biomet said Tuesday it has inked a multi-year extension to its exclusive distribution agreement with Think Surgical. The deal, which extends an agreement signed in 2024, positions Zimmer to continue distributing an exclusive version of Think’s TMINI wireless handheld miniature robotic system. Zimmer’s exclusive version of TMINI is compatible with its Persona knee system, a personalized product used in total knee replacements.
